items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Roy Porter and Sonny Criss and the guitar player, Chuck Norris, and Gene Montgomery, we'd take the horns

ctx.x: Well, he knew that his body was wrecked, you know. His whole nervous system was gone. He had no control over his muscles or his nerves or anything. They just did anything they wanted to do. He couldn't direct their actions.

Anyway, a few days later, they put him in the Camarillo Hospital. And we used to go up to Camarillo a lot of times after we'd finished playing the after-hour places, especially Jack's Basket Room. Roy Porter and Sonny Criss and the guitar player, Chuck Norris, and Gene Montgomery, we'd take the horns and we'd take a snare drum and cymbals and everything, and the guitar, and take a horn for him, and we'd go to Camarillo, and they would let us take him out, and we would go down on to the beach and play -- so he…

But before that, when he was breaking down, I used to take him to the theatres. And that's the only way he seemed to rest, was that the music would put him to sleep. You know, while we were watching the movie, he'd listen to the music, and that's the only way he could rest a little bit.
